title: Jeremiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 33
description: Ten questions on Jeremiah 33: health and cure for the city, the voice of the bridegroom and the bride, and the Branch raised up to David.

questions.text: Where was Jeremiah when Yahweh's word came to him the second time?
questions.explanation: Yahweh's word came to Jeremiah the second time while he was still locked up in the court of the guard.

answers.text: In the land of Benjamin
Still locked up in the court of the guard
In the house of Jonathan the scribe
In the middle gate of the city

questions.text: What did Yahweh invite Jeremiah to do, promising to show him great and difficult things?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said, "Call to me, and I will answer you, and will show you great and difficult things, which you don't know."

answers.text: To call to him
To fast for seven days
To count the stars of the sky
To go up to the high places

questions.text: What did Yahweh say he would bring to this city?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said he would bring it health and cure, would cure them, and would reveal to them abundance of peace and truth.

answers.text: Tribute from all the nations
A new name and a new temple
Health and cure, with peace and truth
Rain in its season and full barns

questions.text: What did Yahweh promise to do with the iniquities by which they had sinned against him?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said he would cleanse them from all their iniquity and pardon all their iniquities by which they had sinned and transgressed against him.

answers.text: Write them on the walls of the city
Repay them on their children
Remember them for forty years
Cleanse them and pardon them all

questions.text: Which voices did Yahweh say would be heard again in the place people called waste?
questions.explanation: In that place there will be heard the voice of joy and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride.

answers.text: The voice of joy and gladness, of the bridegroom and the bride
The voice of mourning and of those who lament
The shout of the watchmen on the walls
The sound of the trumpet and of the army

questions.text: According to Yahweh of Armies, what would be in this waste place and in all its cities again?
questions.explanation: Yahweh of Armies said that there would yet again be in this place a habitation of shepherds causing their flocks to lie down.

answers.text: A camp of soldiers keeping watch
A habitation of shepherds with their flocks
A market of merchants from the sea
A garden of vineyards and olive trees

questions.text: What did Yahweh say he would cause to grow up to David?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said that in those days he would cause a Branch of righteousness to grow up to David, who would execute justice and righteousness in the land.

answers.text: A high wall of defense
A city of refuge
A Branch of righteousness
A sceptre of iron

questions.text: By what name will Jerusalem be called in the days when Judah is saved?
questions.explanation: In those days Judah will be saved and Jerusalem will dwell safely, and this is the name by which she will be called: Yahweh our righteousness.

answers.text: Yahweh is there
The city of the great King
Yahweh our shepherd
Yahweh our righteousness

questions.text: Who, Yahweh said, would not lack a man before him to offer burnt offerings continually?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said the Levitical priests would not lack a man before him to offer burnt offerings, to burn meal offerings, and to do sacrifice continually.

answers.text: The princes of Judah
The Levitical priests
The prophets of Israel
The sons of Rechab

questions.text: What two things did Yahweh compare with the multiplying of the offspring of David his servant?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said that as the army of the sky can't be counted and the sand of the sea can't be measured, so he would multiply the offspring of David and the Levites.

answers.text: The army of the sky and the sand of the sea
The cedars of Lebanon and the oaks of Bashan
The drops of rain and the dew of morning
The flocks of Judah and the herds of Benjamin
